scripts.build:packages: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd apps/vanilla build:package && bun run --cwd packages/vue build && bun run --cwd packages/foldkit build && bun run --cwd packages/routing-libavoid build && bun -e 'for (const root of ["packages/core/dist", "apps/vanilla/dist", "packages/vue/dist", "packages/foldkit/dist"]) for await (const path of new Bun.Glob("**/*.d.ts").scan({ cwd: root })) { const file = `${root}/${path}`; await Bun.write(file, (await Bun.file(file).text()).replace(/\.ts(?=[\x27\x22])/g, ".js")); }'
scripts.build:vue:packages: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/vue build && bun -e 'for (const root of ["packages/core/dist", "packages/vue/dist"]) for await (const path of new Bun.Glob("**/*.d.ts").scan({ cwd: root })) { const file = `${root}/${path}`; await Bun.write(file, (await Bun.file(file).text()).replace(/\.ts(?=[\x27\x22])/g, ".js")); }'
scripts.test:consumer: bun run build:packages && bun run scripts/check-packed-consumer.ts
scripts.dev: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd apps/vanilla dev
scripts.build: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd apps/vanilla build
scripts.docs:check: bun run scripts/generate-api-reference.ts --check && bun run scripts/check-docs.ts
scripts.test:conformance:foldkit: bun run build:packages && playwright test -c apps/foldkit/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:foldkit:hmr: bun run build:foldkit:package && bun run scripts/check-foldkit-hmr.ts
scripts.build:foldkit:package: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/foldkit build && bun -e 'for await (const path of new Bun.Glob("**/*.d.ts").scan({ cwd: "packages/foldkit/dist" })) { const file = `packages/foldkit/dist/${path}`; await Bun.write(file, (await Bun.file(file).text()).replace(/\.ts(?=[\x27\x22])/g, ".js")); }'
